# npnp v3.0.0

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 1. `npnp` now exports a third target, `Cadence`, alongside `Altium` and `KiCad`.
> 2. `3D` models no longer carry the EasyEDA logo by default. Re-export existing libraries to get the new models, or pass `--keep-model-logo` to keep the old ones.

## ✨ Added

### Cadence (OrCAD Capture / Allegro)

- `npnp cadence` writes the same sources SeEx's Cadence export writes:
  - `<library>.xml`, a Capture Library XML that Capture turns into an `.olb` with `File > Import > Library XML`; multi-part EasyEDA symbols become sections of one Capture part;
  - `<library>_allegro/`, one `SKILL` script per footprint plus the library script: `skill load("<folder>/<library>.il")` in the `Allegro PCB Editor` command window builds the `.dra`, `.psm` and `.pad` files;
  - `<library>_step/`, the `3D` models, already mapped where the footprints expect them.
- Standard packages (chip resistors and capacitors, `SOT`, `SOD`, `SOIC`, `QFN`, ...) get `IPC-7352` land patterns checked against the manufacturer's; other packages keep the manufacturer's lands, with silkscreen, assembly layer and place bound generated per `IPC-7352`. The run prints what it checked and what it kept.
- `npnp` runs no Cadence program: the import stays a Capture/Allegro step, exactly as with SeEx.
- `--symbol`, `--footprint`, `--3d`, `--full`, `--append`, `--force`, `--name`, `-j` and `--language` work as they do on the other targets, and the run has the same progress bar.

## 🚀 Improvements

- `--full` exists on every target. It was documented but only `cadence` accepted it; `altium` and `kicad` now do too.
- `--force` is accepted wherever a library may already exist, and the error that suggests `--append` now names `--force` as well, on all three targets.
- `STEP` downloads: total timeout raised from `60 s` to `180 s` (detailed models reach 10 MB), and a failed download now falls back to the `modules.easyeda.com` mirror when `modules.lceda.cn` is unreachable.
- `3D` models are cleaned before they are placed on the board, in both the embedded and standalone paths, so a model is never written with a logo that is about to be removed.
- `npnp p` lists the Cadence commands and a `--keep-model-logo` example.
- Metadata gains `package` and `value` from the symbol parameters, and the 3D model keeps its EasyEDA placement (`c_origin`, `z`, `c_rotation`) — what the Cadence target works from.
- The KiCad symbol and footprint conversion is split into reusable build steps that Cadence reuses; KiCad output is unchanged.
- Docs: the READMEs are rebuilt on SeEx's layout — badges, the workflow diagram and the export showcases.
- Dependencies: `serde_json` 1.0.154, `tokio` 1.54.1.

## 🐞 Fixed

- A fresh clone builds again. `.gitignore` listed `/src`, `/tests`, `/assets`, `/imgs` and `Cargo.lock`, so new files under them were dropped silently while already tracked ones kept committing — the Cadence sources were never committed at all. The ignore file now covers only build output and exported libraries.
- `--force` no longer refuses to start on an existing `Cadence` library, nor on an existing merged Altium `.SchLib`/`.PcbLib`.

## ⚠️ Behaviour changes

- **`3D` models are exported without the EasyEDA logo by default**, for every target. Libraries exported with 2.x keep their logos until they are re-exported. Use `--keep-model-logo` (on `model`, `altium`, `kicad` and `cadence`) to keep the original models.
- When the logo cannot be removed safely, the original model is used and the part is listed in the summary.
- `--force` writes into a library that already exists instead of refusing; `--append` remains the "keep what is there and add" path.
- KiCad keeps its checkpoint behaviour: a part already exported into that library is still skipped even with `--force`, so a repeat run does not re-download a batch. Delete the library (or the checkpoint) to export those parts again.

# npnp v3.0.0（中文）

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 1. `npnp` 现在和 `Altium`、`KiCad` 一样，多了一个导出目标：`Cadence`。
> 2. `3D` 模型默认不再附带立创 EDA 标志。已有的库需要重新导出才会更新，或者用 `--keep-model-logo` 保留原来的模型。

## ✨ 新增

### Cadence（OrCAD Capture / Allegro）

- `npnp cadence` 写出与 SeEx 的 Cadence 导出相同的源文件：
  - `<库名>.xml`：Capture Library XML，在 Capture 中通过 `File > Import > Library XML` 转成 `.olb`；立创 EDA 的多 part 符号会导出为同一个器件的多个 section；
  - `<库名>_allegro/`：每个封装一个 `SKILL` 脚本，外加一个库脚本；在 `Allegro PCB Editor` 命令窗口执行 `skill load("<目录>/<库名>.il")`，即在同一目录生成 `.dra`、`.psm` 和 `.pad`；
  - `<库名>_step/`：`3D` 模型，位置已按封装需要映射好。
- 标准封装（贴片阻容、`SOT`、`SOD`、`SOIC`、`QFN` 等）按 `IPC-7352` 计算焊盘并核对厂家焊盘；其余封装保留厂家焊盘，按 `IPC-7352` 规则生成丝印、装配层和占位区。运行结束会打印核对结果。
- `npnp` 本身不调用任何 Cadence 程序，导入仍然在 Capture / Allegro 中完成，和 SeEx 一致。
- `--symbol`、`--footprint`、`--3d`、`--full`、`--append`、`--force`、`--name`、`-j`、`--language` 的行为与其他目标一致，并带有同样的进度条。

## 🚀 改进

- 每个目标都有 `--full`。文档里一直写着，但之前只有 `cadence` 接受它，`altium` 和 `kicad` 现在也支持。
- 库已存在时 `--force` 都可以使用，提示里也会同时给出 `--force`，三个目标一致。
- `STEP` 下载：总超时由 `60s` 提升到 `180s`（大模型可达 10 MB）；`modules.lceda.cn` 不可用时回退到 `modules.easyeda.com` 镜像。
- `3D` 模型会先在调整板面位置之前去除标志，嵌入和独立导出两条路径都一样，不会先写一个马上要改的模型。
- `npnp p` 增加 Cadence 命令和 `--keep-model-logo` 示例。
- 元数据新增 `package` 与 `value`，`3D` 模型保留立创 EDA 的位置信息（`c_origin`、`z`、`c_rotation`），Cadence 目标依赖这些数据。
- KiCad 的符号/封装转换拆分为可复用的构建步骤，供 Cadence 复用；KiCad 输出保持不变。
- 文档：README 按 SeEx 的版式重做，包含徽章、工作流图和导出示例。
- 依赖：`serde_json` 1.0.154、`tokio` 1.54.1。

## 🐞 修复

- 重新 clone 的项目现在可以正常编译。`.gitignore` 里写了 `/src`、`/tests`、`/assets`、`/imgs` 和 `Cargo.lock`，新文件会被静默忽略（Cadence 源码因此从未进入提交），已跟踪的文件却照常提交。现在只忽略构建产物和导出的库目录。
- `--force` 在已存在的 `Cadence` 库、已存在的 Altium 合并 `.SchLib`/`.PcbLib` 上不再直接报错。

## ⚠️ 行为变化

- **`3D` 模型默认不带立创 EDA 标志**，所有目标一致。用 2.x 导出的库在重新导出前仍保留标志；`--keep-model-logo`（`model`、`altium`、`kicad`、`cadence` 都支持）可保留原始模型。
- 无法安全去除标志时会保留原模型，并在摘要中列出这些元件。
- `--force` 会写入已存在的库，而不是报错；`--append` 仍然是“保留已有内容并新增”。
- KiCad 保留检查点行为：已经导出进该库的元件即使带 `--force` 也会跳过，避免重复运行重新下载整批元件。要重新导出这些元件，请删除对应库（或检查点）。
